issues.reason: Time states that "Time atoms attach to the event witness (or an event-denoting noun like 'the show')", and `sk_moths_2` is a `GroupOf` moth group — an entity, not an eventuality — so `(Time sk_moths_2 third_watch)` is ill-typed.

Status predicates are `(<Status> <event>)`, and a copular clause with no event "wraps the categorical atom in the status operator instead" (`(Past (Member alice happy))`), so a bare `(Past sk_moths_2)` over a group entity is ill-typed in both slots it could have used.

The typing half stands — Core patterns licenses a type atom "exactly when the kind is readable off the words", and "moth-count" reads off `moth`, not `night_moth`, however strongly the previous sentence's nightmoths are the intended referents (world knowledge picks the reading, never the content) — while the dropped `moth_count` compound is acceptable improvisation in the reviewer's own gap territory, since re-expressing the count nominal as a `Cardinality` on the counted set loses no true content.

Quantifiers, generics & scope: "the same rule form distributes a distributive predicate over a plural or group — whether an explicit universal ... or a grouped / counted plural", and only a collective predicate (gather, meet, assemble) stays group-only; staying on the spires is distributive, so the per-member rule over `(PartOf $x sk_skycats_1)` is required alongside the group event.

gaps_confirmed: a count/tally nominal as copular subject with a numeral predicate ("the moth-count at the lantern was seventeen") — the instruction set gives no mapping from a numeric predication on a count noun onto a `Cardinality` (or `Measure`) on the counted set, and no predicate form for a bare numeral (`Measure` needs a stated scale and unit, `Cardinality` needs a group)
new_gaps: A TIME-INDEXED COUNT has no licensed carrier at all: `Time` and the tense operators attach only to eventualities, `Cardinality` takes only a group and a number, and no word in "the moth-count at the lantern was seventeen at the third watch" supplies a state class to reify — so WHEN the count held is unencodable however the clause is routed. A licensed form would need either a `Time`-bearing count state or a time argument on `Cardinality`.

Anaphoric "that night" whose antecedent carries no calendar terms: Time's term-propagation rule then licenses only the bare day-part `(Time e night)` on each event, and nothing identifies the two "that night" events (the gathering, the sky-cats' stay) as the same night, or ties either to the walk anchored only by `(BeforeBy sk_walk_1 sk_equinox_1 1 day)` — co-temporality is silently lost.

Whether a position clause reified by a time modifier (*Where a THING is*) ALSO dual-emits the flat entity-attached position atom — `(On sk_skycats_1 sk_spires_1)` beside the state's `(Location sk_stay_1 sk_spires_1)` — is unspecified: the dual-emit pattern names "a copular clause carrying a time modifier", but the position route is stated separately and shows only the reified half.
defect_summary: `(Time sk_moths_2 third_watch)` has NO compliant form — `Time` requires an eventuality, the improvised `Cardinality` is an entity-level atom, and no word supplies a state class to reify — so "at the third watch" is unencodable here and is filed as a new gap rather than fixed. The tense belongs on the wrapped categorical atom, `(Past (Cardinality sk_moths_2 17))`, never as a bare status atom over a group symbol. The counted group is typed `(GroupOf sk_moths_2 moth)`, the kind the words "moth-count" supply. The sky-cats' stay adds the per-member rule beside the group event: `(Implication (PartOf $x sk_skycats_1) (And (Member (sk_stay $x) stay) (Experiencer (sk_stay $x) $x) (Location (sk_stay $x) sk_spires_1) (Time (sk_stay $x) night) (Past (sk_stay $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9)`.
notes: Sentences 1-5 and 7 track the instruction set closely — the `BeforeBy` equinox anchor, the entity-attached `On` for the station, the name+kind pattern for "Cliff Path" / "Middle Row", the noun-modifier-suppressed compound genera (`mist_light`→`light`, `night_moth`→`moth`, `sky_cat`→`cat`), the `Theme` on `attract`, and the collective `gather` with its `CardinalityPhrase`. The reified `Experiencer` + `Location` state for "stayed on the cliff-spires that night" is itself licensed: a time modifier is one of the named reification triggers for a position clause.
